info.name: TaskFlow — Full API
info.description: Complete TaskFlow backend collection. Set baseUrl, run Auth logins first (tokens auto-save), then work top-down. Vars: accessToken (owner), memberToken, adminToken, organizationId, teamId, projectId, sprintId, taskId, subtaskId, commentId, attachmentId, paymentID, paymentDbId, inviteToken, memberId, testEmail/otp/resetOtp.

request.description: 201 + OTP to email. Copy OTP into otp var.
Uses refreshToken cookie. Test tab re-saves rotated tokens.
Copy reset OTP into resetOtp var.
Set memberId var to target user id.
Select a local file for the 'file' key before sending. Max 5MB (images, pdf, txt, md, zip).
Set attachmentId var from upload/list response.
Open bkashURL to pay in sandbox, then use callback/execute.
Set paymentID var from initiate response (gateway paymentID).
